title: FBR declares thousands of taxpayers inactive over failure to file returns - Investify
text:
FBR declares thousands of taxpayers inactive over failure to file returns | Profit by Pakistan Today | Investify Search stocks, sectors, indices or pages Search stocks, sectors, indices or pages News Tax Quick read FBR declares thousands of taxpayers inactive over failure to file returns
 Profit by Pakistan Today • 2 Nov 2026, 7:43 AM PKT • 1 min read 
 ENG اردو A- A+ Add as preferred source on Google X f The Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) has moved thousands of taxpayers to inactive status after they missed the October 31, 2026 deadline for income tax returns, Profit by Pakistan Today reported. The action took effect after the twice-extended filing period ended, and tax experts said it also covered people who sought an extension on the final day.
 FBR collected Rs4.06 trillion in July-October of fiscal year 2026-27, Rs124 billion below its target, despite a 6% year-on-year rise. Receipts were up Rs220 billion, short of the 17.4% growth needed to reach the annual target of Rs15.263 trillion set under the government’s IMF programme. October collections were Rs974 billion, Rs158 billion below target, with year-on-year growth of 2.5%.
 At a glance
 FBR made thousands of taxpayers inactive after the October 31 filing deadline.
 July-October tax receipts fell Rs124 billion short of target.
 October collections missed the monthly target by Rs158 billion.
 Why it matters
 The inactive-status action and revenue shortfalls put FBR tax collection and the government’s IMF-linked target in focus for investors.
